author: andrewgcodes
name: Optimized Architecture v13
blurb: SP-1024 10x512 KV4 with very large bigram (16384x64), MLP 3x, early SWA (start 30%, every 20 steps), RoPE, Muon weight decay (0.08), 10-layer architecture with Int5 MLP quantization, legal causal test-time training (16-chunk online adaptation, 5 epochs SGD lr=0.003, full model), sliding window eval (stride=64), and int8+zlib roundtrip.
